step1_analysis.description: A pseudo-differential two-stage op-amp featuring a cascoded first stage with current injection for slew-rate/bandwidth enhancement, and a common-source second stage. The non-inverting inputs of the differential pairs are tied to GND, indicating it is designed for switched-capacitor applications where the virtual ground is maintained at 0V.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 10-MHz Clock-Rate 13-Bit CMOS Modulator Using Unity-Gain-Reset Opamps

DC_Gain.description: Low-frequency open-loop voltage gain of the amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: First stage gain ≈ gm * (ro_pmos || gm*ro^2) ≈ 40 dB. Second stage gain ≈ gm * ro ≈ 30 dB. Total ≈ 70 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Two-stage topology without full cascoding on the second stage typically yields 60-80 dB in 130nm.

GBW.description: Unity gain bandwidth (frequency where open-loop gain drops to 0 dB).

sky130_expected.calculation: GBW = gm1 / (2 * pi * C_load). With I_tail = 50µA, gm1 ≈ 250µS. For C_load = 1pF, GBW ≈ 40 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: To support a 10 MHz clock rate with high accuracy, the op-amp GBW must be at least 4-5 times the clock frequency.

Phase_Margin.description: Phase of the open-loop transfer function at the unity-gain frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends heavily on compensation. Since no Miller capacitor is present in the extracted netlist, the PM might be low or negative unless compensated by the load.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Measured open-loop. Without explicit Miller compensation in the netlist, stability relies on load capacitance or external caps.

Power.description: Total static power consumption of the op-amp.

sky130_expected.calculation: 9 bias branches + 1 reference branch = 10 branches. At 50µA per branch, total current = 500µA. Power = 500µA * 1.8V = 0.9 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper reports 5.6 mW for the entire ADC. A single op-amp should consume a fraction of that, around 1 mW.

Slew_Rate.description: Maximum rate of change of the output voltage.

sky130_expected.calculation: SR = I_tail / C_load. With I_tail = 50µA and C_load = 1pF, SR = 50 V/µs.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Required to settle within a fraction of the 100ns clock period.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, GBW, phase margin, power, and slew rate of the pseudo-differential op-amp. It uses a continuous-time DC feedback loop to bias the output at VDD/2 while allowing open-loop AC and large-signal transient injection.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Pseudo-Differential Op-Amp

.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11p=5u L_xm11p=0.5u
.param W_xm9p=5u L_xm9p=0.5u
.param W_xm5p=5u L_xm5p=0.5u
.param W_xm7p=5u L_xm7p=0.5u
.param W_xm7n=5u L_xm7n=0.5u
.param W_xm5n=5u L_xm5n=0.5u
.param W_xm9n=5u L_xm9n=0.5u
.param W_xm11n=5u L_xm11n=0.5u
.param W_xm12p=5u L_xm12p=0.5u
.param W_xm8p=5u L_xm8p=0.5u
.param W_xm2p=5u L_xm2p=0.5u
.param W_xm1p=5u L_xm1p=0.5u
.param W_xm3p=5u L_xm3p=0.5u
.param W_xm4p=5u L_xm4p=0.5u
.param W_xm6p=5u L_xm6p=0.5u
.param W_xm6n=5u L_xm6n=0.5u
.param W_xm1n=5u L_xm1n=0.5u
.param W_xm2n=5u L_xm2n=0.5u
.param W_xm3n=5u L_xm3n=0.5u
.param W_xm4n=5u L_xm4n=0.5u
.param W_xm8n=5u L_xm8n=0.5u
.param W_xm12n=5u L_xm12n=0.5u

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* DUT
XM10 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11P VOUTN N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11p} w={W_xm11p}
XM9P N3 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9p} w={W_xm9p}
XM5P N4 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5p} w={W_xm5p}
XM7P N5 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7p} w={W_xm7p}
XM7N N6 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7n} w={W_xm7n}
XM5N N7 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5n} w={W_xm5n}
XM9N N8 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9n} w={W_xm9n}
XM11N VOUTP N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11n} w={W_xm11n}
XM12P VOUTN N3 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12p} w={W_xm12p}
XM8P N3 VDD N10 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8p} w={W_xm8p}
XM2P N10 GND N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2p} w={W_xm2p}
XM1P N11 VINP N4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1p} w={W_xm1p}
XM3P N11 N11 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3p} w={W_xm3p}
XM4P N10 N11 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4p} w={W_xm4p}
XM6P N5 VDD N11 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6p} w={W_xm6p}
XM6N N6 VDD N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6n} w={W_xm6n}
XM1N N12 VINN N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1n} w={W_xm1n}
XM2N N13 GND N7 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2n} w={W_xm2n}
XM3N N12 N12 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3n} w={W_xm3n}
XM4N N13 N12 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4n} w={W_xm4n}
XM8N N8 VDD N13 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8n} w={W_xm8n}
XM12N VOUTP N8 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12n} w={W_xm12n}

* Power and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
IBIAS N1 0 50u

* Reference Voltage for Output Common Mode
VREF VREF 0 0.9

* P-half DC bias loop and AC/Tran injection
E_bias_P VINP_DC 0 VOUTN VREF 1000
R_lp_P VINP_DC VINP_LF 1Meg
C_lp_P VINP_LF 0 1
V_INP_AC VINP_AC 0 DC 0 AC 1 PULSE(0 0.5 10n 1n 1n 1u 2u)
E_comb_P VINP VINP_AC VINP_LF 0 1

* N-half DC bias loop and AC/Tran injection
E_bias_N VINN_DC 0 VOUTP VREF 1000
R_lp_N VINN_DC VINN_LF 1Meg
C_lp_N VINN_LF 0 1
V_INN_AC VINN_AC 0 DC 0 AC -1 PULSE(0 -0.5 10n 1n 1n 1u 2u)
E_comb_N VINN VINN_AC VINN_LF 0 1

* Load Capacitors
CLOAD_P VOUTN 0 1p
CLOAD_N VOUTP 0 1p

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * AC Analysis
  ac dec 20 1 1G
  let gain_db = vdb(VOUTN)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUTN))
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_gbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1n 3u
  meas tran sr_fall deriv v(VOUTN) when v(VOUTN)=0.9 fall=1
  meas tran sr_rise deriv v(VOUTN) when v(VOUTN)=0.9 rise=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
